spamDialog.title: Mark as spam?
spamDialog.description: The ticket disappears from the queue and cannot be answered until it is restored. The sender is blocked as well: further e-mails from this address become spam tickets and are never answered automatically until this ticket is reopened. This is recorded in the audit log.

closeDialog.title: Close the ticket?
closeDialog.description: A closed ticket can only be reopened; a customer reply reopens it automatically. This is recorded in the audit log.
